messages:
Sofia Alvarez: Hi finance team  traveling to Mexico for a conference next week and needed a business visa. Embassy website only accepted card payments and my Redwood corp card was declined at checkout, so I paid the MXN 3,200 (~$160) with my personal card. The embassy sent an email confirmation with a transaction ID but no formal invoice/receipt. Can I get reimbursed?
Maria Gomez: Thanks for flagging. Quick Q: was any pre-approval obtained for the visa fee? Per policy, visa application fees > $150 require manager approval before purchase unless the corp card fails.
Sofia Alvarez: No pre-approval  I only found out the fee at the appointment. The embassy terminal would not accept the corp card (chip error). I have the emailed confirmation (PDF) that shows payment, transaction ID, applicant name, and amount. I also have my bank statement line and the appointment confirmation PDF.
Owen Park: As Sofia's manager: I approve reimbursement for the visa fee given the on-site requirement and card failure. I'll add a short note in the expense workflow.
Maria Gomez: Ok @Owen thanks. @Sofia please submit expense with: 1) embassy email confirmation PDF, 2) bank statement line showing the posted charge, 3) appointment confirmation/itinerary proving travel purpose, and 4) a one-line note: "Corp card chip error at embassy terminal; personal card used for mandatory visa fee; manager approved." Also redact passport number before uploading (we only need name).
Sofia Alvarez: Uploaded embassy confirmation (https://drive.redwood/travel/visa-176234) and bank screenshot. Redacted passport number per guidance. Anything else?
People Ops: FYI for immigration records: please add the visa type and the conference name in the expense notes so we can link it to your travel authorization. No additional docs required from People Ops unless Finance requests.
Maria Gomez: Finance note: We'll reimburse the posted amount in USD equivalent on your bank statement. Policy: visa fees are reimbursable when required for business travel; pre-approval expected when feasible. If corp card declined, document attempts to use it and get manager approval. Finance Bot will add policy link below.
Finance Bot: Policy excerpt: "Visa and mandatory government fees for approved business travel are reimbursable. Pre-approval required for amounts > $150 unless payment is unavoidable at time of service and corporate card is unavailable. Required docs: vendor payment confirmation or invoice, bank statement line, travel itinerary, manager approval. Personal identifying numbers should be redacted. https://intranet.redwood/fin/visa-fees"
Sofia Alvarez: Expense submitted (EXP-2026-331). Thanks all for the quick turnaround 44d
Maria Gomez: I'll review and process. If anything missing we'll ping you, otherwise expect reimbursement in the next expense cycle.
